faq.question: Do you clean windows at height?
faq.answer: We clean what can be reached safely from the ground, from inside or with appropriate ladders and extension poles. For higher facades we arrange specialised access equipment and tell you in the quote.

faq.question: What happens if it rains?
faq.answer: Light rain does not affect the result. In heavy rain or frost, we reschedule exterior work at no cost to you.

faq.question: Do you clean the frames as well?
faq.answer: Yes. Frames and sills are always included. Shutters, blinds and insect screens can be added.
